description: Frozen MCP resource catalogue (resources/list + resources/read). The JSON payload of each resource is the same read model as the corresponding CLI view, exposed under the shared read-models/MCP response schema refs. Resources are read-only; they are clearance-filtered before counting.

resources.name: today
resources.description: Open commitments and their count (same shape as advisers_today; protected matters excluded at the server clearance).

resources.name: commitments
resources.description: All commitments (open and closed) as compact rows.

resources.name: who
resources.description: Who owes whom: mine (user/agent) vs waiting (third parties).

resources.name: evidence
resources.description: Evidence traceback index for commitments, facts and preferences (counts only).

additiveChanges: 0.3.0: payloads gained optional cap fields (total/truncated/limit/mineTotal/waitingTotal/sourcesTotal/missingTotal); existing fields keep their meaning.
